invoice_lines_values_check.name: invoice_lines_values_check
invoice_lines_values_check.value:
"invoice_lines"."quantity" > 0
        AND "invoice_lines"."unit_price_cents" >= 0
        AND "invoice_lines"."line_total_cents" >= 0
        AND "invoice_lines"."line_total_cents"::bigint
          = "invoice_lines"."quantity"::bigint * "invoice_lines"."unit_price_cents"::bigint
        AND "invoice_lines"."quantity_fulfilled" BETWEEN 0 AND "invoice_lines"."quantity"
        AND (
          "invoice_lines"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL
          OR "invoice_lines"."quantity_fulfilled" = 0
        )

invoices_money_check.name: invoices_money_check
invoices_money_check.value:
"invoices"."currency" = 'INR'
        AND "invoices"."subtotal_cents" >= 0
        AND "invoices"."tax_cents" >= 0
        AND "invoices"."total_cents" >= 0
        AND "invoices"."amount_paid_cents" >= 0
        AND "invoices"."total_cents"::bigint
          = "invoices"."subtotal_cents"::bigint + "invoices"."tax_cents"::bigint
        AND "invoices"."amount_paid_cents" <= "invoices"."total_cents"

invoices_number_format_check.name: invoices_number_format_check
invoices_number_format_check.value:
CASE
        WHEN "invoices"."number" IS NULL THEN true
        WHEN "invoices"."number" !~ '^INV-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4,}$' THEN false
        WHEN coalesce(
          nullif(ltrim(substring("invoices"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0'), ''),
          '0'
        ) = '0' THEN false
        WHEN length(
          ltrim(substring("invoices"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0')
        ) < 10 THEN true
        WHEN length(
          ltrim(substring("invoices"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0')
        ) = 10
          AND ltrim(substring("invoices"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0')
            COLLATE "C" <= '2147483647' COLLATE "C"
        THEN true
        ELSE false
      END

invoices_lifecycle_check.name: invoices_lifecycle_check
invoices_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        (
          "invoices"."status" = 'draft'
          AND "invoices"."number" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."paid_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."amount_paid_cents" = 0
        )
        OR (
          "invoices"."status" = 'issued'
          AND "invoices"."number" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."paid_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."amount_paid_cents" < "invoices"."total_cents"
        )
        OR (
          "invoices"."status" = 'paid'
          AND "invoices"."number" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."amount_paid_cents" = "invoices"."total_cents"
        )
        OR (
          "invoices"."status" = 'void'
          AND "invoices"."number" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."paid_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."amount_paid_cents" = 0
        )
      )

payments_values_check.name: payments_values_check
payments_values_check.value:
"payments"."amount_cents" > 0
        AND CASE
          WHEN "payments"."number" IS NULL THEN false
          WHEN "payments"."number" !~ '^PAY-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4,}$' THEN false
          WHEN coalesce(
            nullif(
              ltrim(substring("payments"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0'),
              ''
            ),
            '0'
          ) = '0' THEN false
          WHEN length(
            ltrim(substring("payments"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0')
          ) < 10 THEN true
          WHEN length(
            ltrim(substring("payments"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0')
          ) = 10
            AND ltrim(substring("payments"."number" from '-([0-9]+)$'), '0')
              COLLATE "C" <= '2147483647' COLLATE "C"
          THEN true
          ELSE false
        END
        AND "payments"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND btrim("payments"."idempotency_key") <> ''

product_variants_values_check.name: product_variants_values_check
product_variants_values_check.value:
"product_variants"."size_ml" > 0
        AND "product_variants"."cost_cents" >= 0
        AND "product_variants"."retail_cents" >= 0
        AND "product_variants"."quantity_on_hand" >= 0
        AND "product_variants"."qty_reserved" >= 0
        AND "product_variants"."reorder_level" >= 0
        AND "product_variants"."version" >= 0
        AND "product_variants"."qty_reserved" <= "product_variants"."quantity_on_hand"

stock_movements_direction_check.name: stock_movements_direction_check
stock_movements_direction_check.value:
(
        ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('receive', 'return') AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('sale', 'damage') AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0)
        OR "stock_movements"."type" = 'adjust'
      )

stock_movements_adjust_note_check.name: stock_movements_adjust_note_check
stock_movements_adjust_note_check.value:
"stock_movements"."type" <> 'adjust'
        OR ("stock_movements"."note" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("stock_movements"."note") <> '')

stock_movements_cost_snapshot_check.name: stock_movements_cost_snapshot_check
stock_movements_cost_snapshot_check.value:
(
        (
          "stock_movements"."type" = 'sale'
          AND "stock_movements"."unit_cost_cents" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."unit_cost_cents" >= 0
          AND "stock_movements"."cost_basis" IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR (
          "stock_movements"."type" <> 'sale'
          AND "stock_movements"."unit_cost_cents" IS NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."cost_basis" IS NULL
        )
      )

commerce_order_items_values_check.name: commerce_order_items_values_check
commerce_order_items_values_check.value: "commerce_order_items"."size_ml_snapshot" > 0 AND "commerce_order_items"."unit_price_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "commerce_order_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "commerce_order_items"."line_total_amount_minor"::bigint = "commerce_order_items"."unit_price_amount_minor"::bigint * "commerce_order_items"."quantity"::bigint AND "commerce_order_items"."fulfilled_quantity" BETWEEN 0 AND "commerce_order_items"."quantity"

commerce_orders_money_check.name: commerce_orders_money_check
commerce_orders_money_check.value: "commerce_orders"."currency" = 'INR' AND "commerce_orders"."subtotal_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "commerce_orders"."shipping_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "commerce_orders"."tax_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "commerce_orders"."discount_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "commerce_orders"."total_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "commerce_orders"."total_amount_minor"::bigint = "commerce_orders"."subtotal_amount_minor"::bigint + "commerce_orders"."shipping_amount_minor"::bigint + "commerce_orders"."tax_amount_minor"::bigint - "commerce_orders"."discount_amount_minor"::bigint

commerce_orders_customer_check.name: commerce_orders_customer_check
commerce_orders_customer_check.value: "commerce_orders"."customer_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "commerce_orders"."guest_email" IS NOT NULL

commerce_settings_money_check.name: commerce_settings_money_check
commerce_settings_money_check.value: "commerce_settings"."currency" = 'INR' AND ("commerce_settings"."flat_shipping_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "commerce_settings"."flat_shipping_amount_minor" >= 0) AND ("commerce_settings"."free_shipping_threshold_minor" IS NULL OR "commerce_settings"."free_shipping_threshold_minor" >= 0)

promotions_values_check.name: promotions_values_check
promotions_values_check.value: "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at" AND ("promotions"."discount_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "promotions"."discount_amount_minor" > 0) AND ("promotions"."discount_percent_basis_points" IS NULL OR "promotions"."discount_percent_basis_points" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000) AND (("promotions"."discount_amount_minor" IS NULL) <> ("promotions"."discount_percent_basis_points" IS NULL)) AND ("promotions"."minimum_order_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "promotions"."minimum_order_amount_minor" >= 0) AND ("promotions"."usage_limit" IS NULL OR "promotions"."usage_limit" > 0)
